jobs.title: Alliance Manager
jobs.description:
About Starburst

Starburst delivers enterprise intelligence at scale by giving organizations secure, governed access to all their data, wherever it lives. Built for distributed data environments, Starburst helps enterprises power AI and analytics without the cost and complexity of traditional data consolidation. With open standards including Trino and Apache Iceberg, Starburst enables trusted access to complete enterprise context while helping organizations avoid vendor lock-in. Leading global enterprises trust Starburst to fuel AI, analytics, and enterprise intelligence. Learn more at starburst.ai .

About the role

Starburst has built a powerful ecosystem of strategic partnerships with some of the most influential names in enterprise infrastructure. As the Analytics Engine for the Nvidia AI Data Platform (AIDP), Starburst sits at the center of one of the most exciting GTM motions in the data and AI space today. Dell OEMs Starburst as a core component of their DataLake offering, while NetApp, Pure, and HPE are certified on Starburst with active CoSell GTM motions- alongside their global and national reseller networks.

The Alliance team is at the forefront of activating and expanding these partnerships, driving engagement and pipeline generation across the full partner ecosystem. It's a high-visibility, high-impact function with strong executive backing and a clear strategy in place.

As an Alliances Manager at Starburst you will :

-  Focus on driving engagement and pipeline generation from our strategic GTM partners (Nvidia, Dell, NetApp, Pure, HPE and their resellers)

-  Identify, Enable, Align and CoSell with all of our Strategic Partners. This is an iterative process with all of our partners as we expand the partnership and drive engagement.

- Deliver partner sourced opportunities and partner sourced closed won ARR.

- Focus on data driven results and follow our defined engagement model. The strategy is set and we are looking for people to help execute on that strategy.

- Track pipeline stages, flag at-risk deals, and work with internal account executives to advance opportunities through the funnel.

- Provide regular pipeline updates and forecasting summaries to leadership and key stakeholders.

Some of the things we look for:

- A background in infrastructure and Data/AI would be expected to have an immediate impact at Starburst.

- Experience in our defined partner ecosystem such as Snowflake, Databricks, Cloudera, Nvidia, Dell, NetApp, Pure, etc.

- Intellectually curious individuals: The Data & AI space is rapidly evolving and to be successful you need to be committed to understanding the space, the growth and the players

- Strong organizational skills with an exceptional attention to detail - you can juggle multiple opportunities without dropping the ball.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills; confident presenting to internal and external stakeholders.

- Proficiency with CRM tools (Salesforce preferred) and standard productivity software (Google Workspace, Slack, Excel/Sheets).

- Self-starter mentality with a bias for action - you proactively follow up, flag issues, and move things forward.

- Exposure to channel, alliances, or indirect sales motions in a SaaS or software environment.

- Experience building or maintaining pipeline/reporting dashboards in tools like Salesforce, Tableau, or Looker.

Where could this role be based?

- London

Build your career at Starburst

All-Stars have the opportunity and freedom to realize their true potential. By building alongside top talent, we’re empowered to take ownership of our careers and drive meaningful change. Anchored in industry-proven technology and unprecedented success, All-Stars are taking on the challenge everyday to disrupt our industry –  and the future.

Our global workforce is supported by a competitive Total Rewards program that reflects our commitment to a rewarding and supportive work environment. This includes a variety of benefits like competitive pay, attractive stock grants, flexible paid time off, and more.

We are committed to fostering an intentional, inclusive, and diverse culture that drives deep engagement, authentic belonging, and an exceptional All-Star experience. We believe that diversity of thought, perspective, background and experience will enable us to own what we do, drive our success and empower our All-Stars to show up authentically.

jobs.title: Director of Sales Enablement
jobs.description:
About Starburst

Starburst delivers enterprise intelligence at scale by giving organizations secure, governed access to all their data, wherever it lives. Built for distributed data environments, Starburst helps enterprises power AI and analytics without the cost and complexity of traditional data consolidation. With open standards including Trino and Apache Iceberg, Starburst enables trusted access to complete enterprise context while helping organizations avoid vendor lock-in. Leading global enterprises trust Starburst to fuel AI, analytics, and enterprise intelligence. Learn more at starburst.ai .

About the Role

Starburst is hiring a Head of Sales Enablement to own how our sellers ramp, learn, and execute — and to make sure that knowledge shows up as measurable productivity, not just completed training. This is a leadership role at the intersection of enablement, systems, and operations: you will set the enablement strategy and content standard for the sales organization, and you will partner directly with BizApps to get the right guidance, playbooks, and prompts embedded into the tools reps use every day, and with Field Operations to target enablement investment at the productivity gaps the data actually shows.

You are the right fit if you have built enablement programs before and have gotten tired of them living in a content library that nobody opens mid-deal. We want someone who thinks of enablement as an operating system for seller behavior, delivered in the flow of work, and measured the same way the business measures everything else: ramp time, pipeline generation, conversion, and quota attainment.

As a Director of Sales Enablement at Starburst, you will:

- Enablement strategy and roadmap: define the onboarding/ramp program, ongoing skill development, sales methodology, and certification path for all customer-facing roles.

- Partnership with BizApps: work jointly on the sales tech stack (CRM, sales engagement, enablement platform) so playbooks, battlecards, and next-best-action guidance are surfaced inside seller workflows rather than in a separate portal.

- Partnership with Field Operations: use territory, pipeline, and productivity data from Field Ops to prioritize what gets built and to whom it's targeted, rather than running enablement as a one-size-fits-all calendar of sessions.

- Seller productivity metrics: co-own a shared definition of seller productivity with BizApps and Field Ops (e.g., ramp-to-productivity time, activity-to-pipeline conversion, win rate by cohort) and report on it regularly to sales leadership.

- Content and messaging governance: ensure playbooks, competitive positioning, and pitch materials stay current with product and market changes, in partnership with Product Marketing.

- Manager enablement: equip frontline sales managers to reinforce and coach to the same standard, not just train individual reps.

- Team leadership: hire, develop, and manage the enablement team, and manage the enablement budget and vendor relationships (LMS, enablement platform, content tools).

- Program measurement: run a regular cadence of reviewing what's working, retiring what isn't, and tying every major enablement investment to a productivity or revenue outcome.

Some of the things we look for:

- 8+ years in sales enablement, sales productivity, or revenue/GTM operations in B2B SaaS, including 3+ years leading a team.

- A track record of partnering with a systems/BizApps or Salesforce team to build workflows and guided selling into the CRM and sales engagement stack, not just producing content.

- Comfort working from data: able to define productivity KPIs with Field Ops/RevOps, read a pipeline or ramp report, and adjust enablement priorities based on it.

- Experience designing onboarding and certification programs for complex, technical, or platform-based sales motions.

- Strong stakeholder management across sales leadership, marketing, product, and operations, with the credibility to say no to low-impact requests.

- Hands-on experience with enablement and sales engagement platforms (e.g., Highspot, Seismic, Mindtickle, Gong, Outreach, Salesloft, or equivalents).

- Experience in data, analytics, or infrastructure/platform sales is a plus given Starburst's technical buyer and seller audience.

- Ability to Travel : This role will require 25% in-person travel for purposes including but not limited to new hire onboarding, team and department offsites, customer engagements, and other company events. Actual travel expectations may vary by role and business needs.

Starburst is dedicated to maintaining fair and equitable compensation practices. The salary range provided for this role reflects the minimum and maximum targets for candidates across all U.S. locations and could be inclusive of variable compensation, such as commission or bonus. All employees receive equity packages (ISOs) and have access to a comprehensive benefits offering. Actual compensation packages are determined based on relevant skills, experience, education and training, and specific work location. For more information, connect with the recruiting team or Hiring Manager during the process as they can provide more detailed information about the salary range.

Pay Range
$185,000 — $225,000 USD

The role will support tactical items that align with the Regional Sales Leadership, Regional Sales teams, as well as Marketing leadership. The successful candidate will be expected to collaborate and execute while maintaining a metric-driven success criteria and approach.

- Track program performance, report results, and recommend optimizations.

- Own event logistics, budgets, timelines, and vendor coordination.

Some of the things we look for:

- 3+ years of experience in field marketing, demand generation, or related B2B marketing roles.

- Ability to collaborate across sales, marketing, and external partners.

- Willingness to travel for field events.

- Highly detail-oriented and creative, thriving in fast-paced, collaborative environments.

- Passionate about creative thinking and experiential event planning , with a focus on delivering memorable, measurable, and impactful experiences.

- Experience in B2B software, data, or infrastructure marketing.

jobs.description:
About Starburst

Starburst delivers enterprise intelligence at scale by giving organizations secure, governed access to all their data, wherever it lives. Built for distributed data environments, Starburst helps enterprises power AI and analytics without the cost and complexity of traditional data consolidation. With open standards including Trino and Apache Iceberg, Starburst enables trusted access to complete enterprise context while helping organizations avoid vendor lock-in. Leading global enterprises trust Starburst to fuel AI, analytics, and enterprise intelligence. Learn more at starburst.ai .

About the role

We're looking for an HR Manager to be a local culture and talent partner to our EMEA R&D organization. This is a hands-on, locally-embedded role where you’ll build trust with leaders and engineers face-to-face, own the full hire-to-retain lifecycle for the region, provide backup support for ongoing operations in region, and bring a local lens to programs designed centrally. This role will have direct influence on shaping the employee experience and culture in our R&D organization.

As an HR Manager, EMEA R&D at Starburst you will drive:

Culture & Team Health

- Maintain an active, visible presence in the Warsaw office (minimum 3 days/week) and attend key meetings in person, not remotely.

- Run regular 1:1s with first-line managers to stay close to team health and emerging feedback themes.

- Conduct exit interviews for EMEA & APJ Engineering, analyzing turnover trends to partner with leaders on action plans.

- Turn Feedback Survey results and other cultural indicators into specific, tracked action items for EMEA Engineering.

- Surface emerging issues to key leadership and maintain a consistent pulse on employee sentiment.

Talent & Hiring

- Design and run a local hiring and onboarding program tailored to the region, complementary to our global onboarding practices.

- Own sourcing and screening for regional engineering roles, building and maintaining a local candidate pipeline.

- Design the interview loop in partnership with the Hiring Manager and set clear expectations for interviewer goals and responsibilities.

- Manage new hire logistics from start to finish: offers, day 1 readiness, and compliance.

- Build local market presence and influence to strengthen our employer brand in the region.

- Champion internal mobility opportunities for engineers across the region, while ensuring we maintain fairness and equity across the process.

Additional Scope

While we build out longer-term operational coverage, this role will also provide secondary support across the following areas to ensure continuity and no gaps in coverage:

Office Management

- Serve as a secondary point of contact for day-to-day Warsaw office operations, providing coverage during absences, peak periods, or as workload requires.

- Partner closely with the current Office Management & People Operations Specialist to stay looped in on ongoing priorities and vendor/facilities matters. Ensure feedback is mapped into local cultural connection points to keep teammates engaged.

EMEA Operations Support

- Provide backup support for EMEA People Ops activities including employee lifecycle transactions, stepping in during PTO, surge periods, or as capacity needs dictate.

- Work alongside the current Office Management & People Operations Specialist to maintain consistent employee experience.

Some of the things we look for:

- 3-5 years of HR experience; prior experience partnering with an Engineering or technical organization is a plus but not required

- Fluency in English and Polish

- Strong stakeholder management skills; comfortable building trust and driving alignment with cross-functional partners

- A track record of turning employee feedback and insight into action items that visibly move the needle on team culture

- Ability to Travel : This role will require 25% in-person travel for purposes including but not limited to new hire onboarding, team and department offsites, customer engagements, and other company events. Actual travel expectations may vary by role and business needs.

Where could this role be based?

- This role is based in our Warsaw office and follows a hybrid model, with an expectation of being onsite 2-3 days per week.
